entities.name: PMID:25072831
observations: 2014 American Journal of Ophthalmology Raine cohort study: myopia in young adults was inversely related to an objective marker of ocular sun exposure; DOI 10.1016/j.ajo.2014.07.033.

entities.name: PMID:35570945
observations: 2022 Raine Study review reports a negative relationship between myopia prevalence and time outdoors, using conjunctival ultraviolet autofluorescence (CUVAF) area as an objective sun-exposure measure; smaller CUVAF indicates less sun exposure.

entities.name: Myopia-CUVAF inverse association
observations: Raine cohort evidence indicates lower myopia prevalence with greater objective ocular sun-exposure marker (CUVAF) area; observational association does not establish causality.
